## DDNet Staff List
The link below will give you a full list of all DDNet staff members.

**URL:** https://ddnet.org/staff/

### [DDNet config directory:](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/FAQ#Where_is_the_DDNet_config,_config_directory_or_save_directory?)
__**On Windows:**__
Old: `%appdata%\Teeworlds`
New: `%appdata%\DDNet`
__**On Linux:**__
Old: `~/.teeworlds`
New: `~/.local/share/ddnet`
__**On macOS:**__
Old: `~/Library/Application Support/Teeworlds`
New: `~/Library/Application Support/DDNet`
__**On Android:**__
New: `/Android/data/org.ddnet.client/files/user`

## How can I get other players to see the skin that I created?
There are two ways to get other players to see your custom skin: 

**Method 1:** 
They need to manually add your skin to their game files by pasting it in the skins folder in the config directory. 

**Method 2:** 
Your skin gets added to the official SkinDB. 

For more info on how to get your skin uploaded to the SkinDB, visit this channel: <#{Channels.SKIN_INFO}>

## Crash Reporting
To help us debug the cause for your crash, provide the following information:
* Operating system
   - Windows, Linux, macOS, or Android?
   - 32 Bit or 64 Bit?
* DDNet client version
   - Steam or standalone?
   - Stable, nightly, or release candidate?
* Upload the most recent *crash log* and *assert log* files from the `dumps` folder in your config directory (drag and drop it here with its original filename). Note that crash logs are currently only available on Windows.
[btn:configdir:Config Directory Location]

text.en: In-game Ranks and saves may occasionally fail to be inserted in our database. This can happen for various reasons, including poor connectivity to our main database due to lag or hoster issues. However, there's no need to worry! The ranks and saves are stored locally and will be attempted to be inserted again within the next 24 hours.

## Graphics Troubleshooting

Refer to the [Graphics troubleshooting guide](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/GFX_Troubleshooting) on our Wiki, which explains possible solutions for various graphics-related problems such as:
- [Game not starting](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/GFX_Troubleshooting#Game_not_starting)
- [Some text is invisible with the Vulkan backend](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/GFX_Troubleshooting#Some_text_is_invisible_with_the_Vulkan_backend)
- [Client crashes with Vulkan "device lost" error](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/GFX_Troubleshooting#Client_crashes_with_Vulkan_%22device_lost%22_error)
- [Low FPS, stuttering or other problems](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/GFX_Troubleshooting#Low_FPS,_stuttering_or_other_problems)
For general troubleshooting guidance also refer to the [Troubleshooting guide](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/Troubleshooting) on our Wiki.

### [How to bind and configure deepfly](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/Binds#Deepfly):
We highly recommended to read this [article](https://wiki.ddnet.org/wiki/Binds#Deepfly).

### To get you started, follow the instructions below:
Move the attached text file to your config directory and then type: ```exec deepfly.txt``` into the ingame console (F1).
[btn:"configdir":Config Directory]
To toggle deepfly on/off, press "C" on your keyboard.
